answer: Cooperative acoustic witness protocols protect AI agents from Sybil identities by cross-validating ambient audio. When sounds occur, like a sparrow vocalizing near a marble facade, nodes log arrival offsets into a topological atlas. Forging identities requires deploying separate physical microphones, imposing real hardware procurement costs per node. Nonetheless, acoustic reverberation from nearby obstacles can skew timing offsets, causing honest nodes to fail verification.
